scope.summary: Port read_file_artifact (storage-agnostic, from reference MT-043) and land the verified media byte route on SurrealDB. Store-level AtelierStore::read_media_asset_bytes owns the integrity contract (row -> native ref -> manifest -> row/manifest hash+size cross-check -> single-file -> payload re-hash); HTTP maps outcomes (404 unknown/missing payload, 400 non-native ref, 500 integrity).
acceptance_criteria: AC1 exact stored bytes served with catalog MIME, Content-Length, ETag "sha256-<hex>", Cache-Control private,immutable, x-hsk-artifact-ref, x-hsk-content-sha256
AC2 unknown asset 404; payload deleted after cataloguing 404; tampered payload 500 and never the tampered bytes
AC3 embedded SurrealDB harness only, no PG, no skip paths
